sentences.sentence: Hang a hammock; lie in it.
sentences.translation: 挂上一个吊床，然后躺在里面。

sentences.sentence: Many nights, I cried silently in my hammock, tears of self-pity streaming down my face.
sentences.translation: 许多个晚上，我在吊床上静静地哭泣，自伤自怜的泪水顺着脸往下淌。

sentences.sentence: But when I started to read the journals that I'd written in my hammock each night, I realised that I'd been pretty miserable for large parts of the journey.
sentences.translation: 但是当我开始阅读在旅行中我每个夜晚在吊床上写下的文字时，我才意识到，在这次旅程的大部分时间里，我都是倍受折磨和煎熬的。

sentences.sentence: She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
sentences.translation: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

sentences.sentence: An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
sentences.translation: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

translations.translation: 切断腿筋使成跛腿；使残废

sentences.sentence: Meanwhile, work on strengthening and stretching your hip, hamstring and lower-back muscles.
sentences.translation: 与此同时还要拉伸和增强你臀部、腿筋和腰背部的肌肉。

sentences.sentence: Far more telling was the correlation between the various runners’ tight or loose hamstring muscles and their running economy, a measure of how much oxygen they used while striding.
sentences.translation: 进一步讲，不同跑步者腿筋肌的松紧和步伐频率是有联系的，这是一种对他们在跨步行进时耗氧量的评估。

sentences.translation: 拉伸方面——特别要关注腿筋拉伸、髋关节和腰背部拉伸、腿筋和背部锻炼。

sentences.translation: 我已经让汤姆回去取你的手提袋了。

sentences.sentence: He stopped just as his truck tilted down the steep incline, put on the handbrake, and stepped out.
sentences.translation: 就在他的卡车沿陡峭的斜坡向下滑的时候，他停了下来，拉住了手闸，然后下了车。

sentences.sentence: They tried to handcuff him but, despite his injuries, he fought his way free.
sentences.translation: 他们试图用手铐铐住他，但尽管他受了伤，还是奋力挣脱了。

sentences.sentence: He was led away to jail in handcuffs.
sentences.translation: 他戴着手铐被送进监狱。

sentences.translation: 那里只有几个人。

sentences.sentence: Stumbling through the smoke, the pilot emerged from the forward compartment, fumbled for the handgun at his belt.
sentences.translation: 烟雾间出现了飞行员跌跌撞撞的身影，他的手笨拙地摸索着腰带上的手枪。

sentences.sentence: Police recovered an illegal handgun from the car, initially raising questions about whether Mr. Duggan had fired on one of the officers.
sentences.translation: 警方从那辆出租车里找回一支非法手枪，曾一开始令外界怀疑杜干是否曾向一名警察开枪。

sentences.sentence: One of the criminals immediately shoved a .38 caliber handgun to my head, ordered me to the cooler, pushed me down on the floor, and pumped a bullet into the back of my head - execution style.
sentences.translation: 其中一个匪徒迅速掏出一把口径为38毫米的手枪用力指著我的头，勒令我走到冷冻机旁，然后把我推倒在地，像执行死刑般从后面朝我头部开了一枪。

hammer
音标：英 /'hæmə/  美 /'hæmɚ/

短语：forging hammer — 锻锤

hammock
音标：英 /'hæmək/  美 /'hæmək/
n. 吊床；吊铺；吊带
vt. 睡吊床
例句：Hang a hammock; lie in it.
挂上一个吊床，然后躺在里面。
例句：Many nights, I cried silently in my hammock, tears of self-pity streaming down my face.
许多个晚上，我在吊床上静静地哭泣，自伤自怜的泪水顺着脸往下淌。
例句：But when I started to read the journals that I'd written in my hammock each night, I realised that I'd been pretty miserable for large parts of the journey.
但是当我开始阅读在旅行中我每个夜晚在吊床上写下的文字时，我才意识到，在这次旅程的大部分时间里，我都是倍受折磨和煎熬的。

hamper
音标：英 /'hæmpə/  美 /'hæmpɚ/
v. 妨碍；束缚；使困累
n. 食盒，食篮；阻碍物
例句：She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。
例句：An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

hamstring
音标：英 /'hæmstrɪŋ/  美 /'hæmstriŋ/
n. 腿筋
v. 切断腿筋使成跛腿；使残废
例句：Meanwhile, work on strengthening and stretching your hip, hamstring and lower-back muscles.
与此同时还要拉伸和增强你臀部、腿筋和腰背部的肌肉。
例句：Far more telling was the correlation between the various runners’ tight or loose hamstring muscles and their running economy, a measure of how much oxygen they used while striding.
进一步讲，不同跑步者腿筋肌的松紧和步伐频率是有联系的，这是一种对他们在跨步行进时耗氧量的评估。
例句：For stretching, focus on the hamstring stretch, the hip &lower-back stretch, and the hamstring &back stretch.
拉伸方面——特别要关注腿筋拉伸、髋关节和腰背部拉伸、腿筋和背部锻炼。
